# OAgents Prompt Attribution

ORM_list_wise.yaml is the unmodified OAgents list-wise selection prompt,
retrieved from the upstream repository:

https://github.com/OPPO-PersonalAI/OAgents

The OccuBench adapter uses the prompt to select among four public trajectories.
The upstream OAgents benchmark/model results are not claimed as reproduced:
OccuBench's task environment, agent runner, and model endpoint differ.
The adaptation and its deviations are documented in the root README.

The upstream license is included in LICENSE.
